text: The B.S. in Computer Science degree plan (2021-2022 Catalog) requires 124 total hours for graduation, which must include 51 hours as Upper Division. The plan totals 73 lower-division hours and 51 upper-division hours: Major Preparatory Requirements (39 lower-division hours); Major Core Requirements (51 upper-division hours); Remaining Core Curriculum (24 lower-division hours); and Electives (10 hours, requires approval from advisor). Students must have a minimum cumulative 2.0 GPA in all UTD coursework and a cumulative 2.0 GPA in all Major requirements to graduate. Students must also complete 45 hours in residence and complete 24 of the last 30 hours at UTD. No off-campus courses in the last semester are allowed.
source_title: B.S. in Computer Science Degree Plan (2021-2022 Catalog)
section_heading: B.S. in Computer Science: Degree Totals and Graduation Requirements

text: B.S. in Computer Science (2021-2022 Catalog) degree plan notes: (1) Major Requirement: must earn a C or better to receive credit. (2) Course meets both Major and CORE requirement. (3) Must take Math 2413/2414 or Math 2417/2419. (4) Other course options available; see Advisor for details. (5) A maximum of 3 PHIN credits is allowed on any UTD degree plan. (6) Lower or upper division courses may count as free electives. (7) Incoming freshmen (FTIC) must enroll and complete requirements of UNIV 1010 and the corresponding school-related freshmen seminar course. (8) All students, including transfer students, who complete their core curriculum at UT Dallas must take UNIV 2020.

text: B.S. in Computer Science (2021-2022 Catalog) Major Preparatory Requirements (39 lower-division hours), computing courses: ECS 1100 Intro to Engineering and CS (1 hour; FTIC freshman seminar per note 7); CS 1200 Intro to CS and SE (2 hours); CS 1336 Programming Fundamentals (3 hours; major requirement, C or better); CS 1136 Computer Science Laboratory (1 hour); CS 1337 Computer Science I (3 hours; major requirement, C or better); CS 2305 Discrete Mathematics for Computing I (3 hours; major requirement, C or better); CS 2336 or 2337 Computer Science II (3 hours; major requirement, C or better); and CS 2340 Computer Architecture (3 hours).

text: B.S. in Computer Science (2021-2022 Catalog) Major Preparatory Requirements, mathematics and physics courses: MATH 2413 or 2417 Calculus I (4 hours); MATH 2414 or 2419 Calculus II (4 hours); MATH 2418 Linear Algebra (4 hours); PHYS 2325 Mechanics (3 hours); PHYS 2125 Physics Laboratory I (1 hour); PHYS 2326 Electromagnetism and Waves (3 hours); and PHYS 2126 Physics Laboratory II (1 hour). Calculus I, Calculus II, PHYS 2325, PHYS 2125, and PHYS 2326 meet both a Major and CORE requirement. Students must take Math 2413/2414 or Math 2417/2419. The Major Preparatory Requirements total 39 lower-division hours.
